decisions.statement: The page is committed and the file beside that page is not.
A line is one row of whatever the check keeps.
A check reads its own cache and no other check's.
A cache that is not there has the check work its answer out in full.
A check writes its cache only where that check worked its answer out in full.
No page states its own cache.

definition: what a check works out once and reads again rather than working out on every run
